description:
Use Cases: Recovery following exercise or physical activity
Best For: Post-exercise, Athletes, Active adults
Why It Works: Light recovery loosens worked tissue; the cold close reduces post-exercise inflammation and settles the body into parasympathetic recovery.

Use Cases: Persistent tension · Deep recovery support · Restoration
Best For: Lasting tension, Deep restoration, Extra-attention areas
Why It Works: Our signature three-part flow: a calming sequence helps the body settle, a reset phase shifts the rhythm, and deeper work completes the session — designed for areas that benefit from a thorough, layered approach.

Use Cases: Full-spectrum recovery · Restoration · Relaxation
Best For: Full recovery, Everyday tension, Restoration days
Why It Works: A complete recovery flow — warmth to begin, deeper work in the middle, and a cooling finish — designed to support full-body restoration and relaxation.

Use Cases: Recovery support · Fluid movement-focused sessions
Best For: Post-travel heaviness, Fluid balance, Recovery
Why It Works: Two flowing, fluid-focused sequences paired together, finishing with a cooling phase — designed to support a light, refreshed feeling.

Use Cases: Travel recovery · Low energy · Time-zone adjustment
Best For: Frequent travelers, Daytime arrival, Shift workers
Why It Works: Gentle warmth helps prepare the body, then an energizing sequence supports a refreshed, alert feeling — ideal for re-anchoring to a new daytime rhythm.

Use Cases: Pre-workout preparation · Athletic performance · Muscle activation
Best For: Athletes, Pre-competition, Strength training
Why It Works: Warmth helps prepare the muscles, dynamic stimulation supports mobility and readiness, and an energizing finish helps you feel primed for activity.

Use Cases: Stretching · Exercise preparation · Mobility work
Best For: Pre-stretching, Mobility work, Yoga/Pilates prep
Why It Works: Warmth and dynamic movement help prepare the joints and muscles, finishing with a stretch-focused sequence so the body feels ready to move.

Use Cases: Wellness routines · Circulation support · Energizing sessions
Best For: Wellness clients, Circulation focus, Energy boost
Why It Works: Gentle warmth, a flowing rhythmic sequence, and an energizing finish — designed to support circulation and a refreshed, energized feeling.

Use Cases: Muscle soreness · Recovery · Relaxation
Best For: Muscle soreness, Tension, Recovery
Why It Works: A gentle softening sequence helps the muscles relax, followed by deeper work — a streamlined recovery session.

Use Cases: Circulation-focused wellness and recovery sessions
Best For: Circulation focus, Recovery, Wellness
Why It Works: Two complementary contrast sequences followed by deeper work — designed to support circulation and a refreshed, restored feeling.

Use Cases: Abdominal wellness · Core-area comfort sessions
Best For: Abdominal wellness, Core comfort
Why It Works: Gentle warmth and contrast over the core area, finishing with a relaxing sequence — designed to support a comfortable, settled feeling.
